caption: A moth flies into a hanging bug zapper on a porch, and there is a brief crackle and flash at the grid.

sa.check: A bug zapper hangs on a porch.
A moth flies toward the zapper.
A brief flash appears at the grid.
The flash comes as the moth meets the grid, not before.

pc.expect: The flash is brief and at the point where the moth meets the grid; the grid is dark before and after.
pc.fail: The grid flashes while the moth is still well clear of it; or the flash glows on for the rest of the clip; or the flash appears at a place on the grid away from the moth; or the grid flashes repeatedly with nothing touching it.

pc.expect: One zapper and one moth; the zapper keeps its shape and place; the flash leaves nothing glowing behind.
pc.fail: A second zapper or moth appears from nowhere; or the zapper vanishes; or a glowing spot stays on the grid after the flash; or the moth passes through the grid and flies on unchanged.

pc.expect: After the flash the moth drops or falls away from the grid; anything that falls goes downward.
pc.fail: The moth rises from the grid after the flash and hangs in the air; or falls upward; or a fallen moth rises back to the grid.
pc.precondition: The moth's fate after the flash is in view.

pc.expect: The zapper hangs still or swings only gently; the porch furniture stays put.
pc.fail: The zapper swings hard at the flash with nothing touching it; or jumps to a new spot; or porch furniture shifts at the flash.

pc.expect: The zapper is a rigid cage that stays whole; the moth meets the grid from outside.
pc.fail: The grid bends or melts; or the moth passes through the cage wall and out the other side unchanged; or the zapper's housing changes shape; or the hook detaches and the zapper hangs in the air.

pc.expect: The zapper's colour and the porch's colours stay the same apart from the flash.
pc.fail: The zapper changes colour; or the porch wall changes colour; or the zapper's glow changes colour when it is not flashing.

note: The moth is an animal and its flight is not judged. The crackle is sound and is not judged.
